title: 15 open source backup solutions to protect your data in 2026
summary: A short survey of 15 open-source backup tools in three groups: network and command-line tools (Amanda, BackupPC, Bacula, BorgBackup, Rclone, restic), desktop tools (Back In Time, Déjà Dup, Duplicati, Timeshift, UrBackup and others), and newer options (Kopia, Syncthing), each with one line and its licence. Good for finding names to look into; it doesn’t compare them in depth.
